comment: With !verbose, the Archeologist opens her sack (escaped), then takes off her fedora and leather jacket from the inventory menu. invent.c ddoinv() calls dispinv_with_action(), which hands the picked item to iactions.c itemactions(), whose itemactions_pushkeys() queues the command and the item letter, and invent.c getobj() takes the letter from cmdq_pop() without a prompt.
